method:
Southern work props through native UI and ordinary-time software Chromium.

A disposable profile imports the checked-in command-earned Chapter I checkpoint
as a new character. Visible Roads/trail routes, accept/step/choice/claim controls,
WASD/F/G, pause and V own all movement/progression. No test mode, coordinate write,
direct rule command, accelerated tick, progress grant or personal save is used.
Read-only observers inspect actual production submissions. Labelled appearance-
only one-frame ablations preserve identical render arguments and restore writer,
batches, state, camera and collision before the next simulation frame. A labelled
native-storage quota refusal tests the real UI save boundary and is restored.
This is software integration/pixel evidence, not hardware cost or human approval.

atlantis.title: A Chart With Room for Depth
atlantis.summary: Sahra needs one visitor chart that distinguishes the old lower road, the modern wet lane and Bellglass’s air court. Read both depth marks, correct the chart in the court, and add a modern marker beside the old masonry.
atlantis.danger: This job enters the existing bounded gallery. F ascends, G descends, and depth holds when released. The visitor envelope has no breath timer. Bellglass’s doorway and the east wet lane remain the way out; free passage home remains available.
atlantis.completionText: “There. A traveler can see the depth before choosing the lane. The older mark keeps its place, and the new one says what is safe today.” Sahra keeps the corrected visitor chart. This small commission does not settle the missing cargo or the harbour’s disputed receipts.

steps.name: Read the upper visitor gauge
steps.text: The bronze gauge labels a shallower visitor depth. Read it from the water at this level; the public deck overhead is a separate road. Sahra’s instrument records this first depth without taking any material.

steps.name: Compare the old lower-road mark
steps.text: Descend to the older worked-stone mark. Its lower depth differs from the visitor gauge. The old address is still useful history: copy the mark, leave the masonry intact, and carry both readings to Bellglass.

steps.name: Correct the chart in the Bellglass air court
steps.text: The two readings cannot share one flat route line. At the dry court desk, choose a chart that names both depth layers, marks their connection and shows the court’s doorway. You can correct a mistaken choice without spending supplies.

choices.label: Draw one flat line through every marker
choices.text: The marks have different measured depths. One flat line hides the change and makes the court look like part of the wet lane. Keep the readings and try another chart.

choices.label: Show two depth layers, their connection and the air-court doorway
choices.text: The chart distinguishes the shallower visitor gauge, the lower old road and the dry court. It also marks the east wet lane to the far landing. These lines describe the actual bounded passage.

choices.label: Erase the old mark and draw only the modern lane
choices.text: The modern lane needs a clear marker, but the old address is still evidence. Add the present safe route without deleting the lower-road record. No supplies are spent by this choice.

steps.name: Fit the modern landing marker
steps.text: Leave through Bellglass’s open doorway, follow the wet east lane, and place the new marker beside the far landing. It names today’s visitor route; the old lower-road mark remains. Return to Sahra on the dry civic road to claim the declared payment.

earthlands.title: Wood, Reed and a Road Home
earthlands.summary: Vessa offers one supply commission across Coastward’s coppice and shore spurs. Prepare a fallen bough, a small reed bundle and loose shore stone, then pack the job supplies beside the bridge. The paid bundle uses existing crafting materials.
earthlands.danger: The coppice has one territorial skitter farther south. The northern lip of the spur gives a clear approach to the fallen bough. No fight is required. Stay on the supported road and shore overlook; this outing adds no Earth swimming, boats or harvesting of standing trees.
earthlands.completionText: “Sound bough, tied reeds, loose stone. You brought back useful things without taking the shelter trees.” Vessa releases the six timber, four meadow fibre and two stone from this one commission. They can supply an ashwood trail bow at an existing workbench, or another existing recipe you choose. The road and bridge stay open.

steps.name: Prepare the fallen coppice bough
steps.text: Follow the north side of the coppice spur to the loose fallen bough. Trim and tie the sound pieces for Vessa’s order. The standing woodland trees and the existing homestead resource nodes are untouched; these pieces belong to the accepted job until its claim.

steps.name: Tie the shore reed bundle
steps.text: On the supported shore overlook, gather the marked cut reeds and tie them above the damp ground. Keep the living bank cover in place. This finite bundle is an ordinary meadow-fibre supply, not a new currency or an unlimited harvest.

steps.name: Sort the loose shore stone
steps.text: Sort the small loose stones from the marked dry stack. Leave the overlook foundation where it is. These two pieces are for Vessa’s order; Darric’s reserved public stone, the quarry story and all earlier payouts keep their separate ownership.

steps.name: Pack the three supplies by the bridge
steps.text: Return by the east woodland road and the physical timber bridge. Tie the three prepared supplies into one load at the arrival bank, then speak to Vessa nearby. Packing records the completed job; the declared materials enter your ordinary inventory only when its once-only claim succeeds.

definition.name: Atlantis · Farwake and Bellglass
definition.kicker: A continuing maritime civilization · one bounded visitor route
definition.description: A dry arrival pier leads to Farwake’s sheltered civic court. Beside the public causeway, a marked optional submerged gallery contains a small Bellglass visitor air court and a separate landing.
definition.sourceNotes: Farwake, Bellglass, Nereme and Sahra come from the recovered Atlantis proposal. This local civic check and gallery blockout are original bounded foundations; the Harbour Beneath the Harbour campaign remains unresolved.

points.name: Free home passage
points.text: Nereme keeps a dry route home available.
points.detail: Return is independent of the work commission and optional gallery. No allegiance, dive or breath purchase is required.

points.name: Nereme · pilot
points.text: Arriving or returning? Either way, learn where the landing is before admiring the towers.
points.detail: The civic court and far quay have a continuous dry route. The marked gallery is a bounded visitor dive with explicit depth controls; the public visitor protection has no drowning timer.

points.name: Sahra · instrument-maker
points.text: A dial is useful when someone can compare it with what the water actually does.
points.detail: Sahra’s workshop remains distinct from Oren’s. This local inspection does not resolve Vaelor, Damar, the Custodian or the larger regional campaign.

points.name: Public route lamp
points.text: Check the lamp marking the dry court approach.
points.detail: Confirm the ordinary visitor route. Decorative distant lights are not travel gates.

points.name: Civic tide dial
points.text: Compare the civic dial with its posted calibration mark.
points.detail: This is a local instrument check. It does not establish the later harbour fraud or require joining a school.

points.name: Visitor route register
points.text: Post the completed local visitor-route inspection.
points.detail: The named public check can be recorded without descending. It grants no ancestry, class or allegiance.

points.name: Tide Steps · optional gallery entry
points.text: Inspect the bounded gallery route and enter deliberately.
points.detail: The protected entry transfers to the gallery beside the quay. Ascend and descend remain explicit; hold depth is available. The dry public road stays open.

points.name: Gallery landing · dry exit
points.text: Leave the visitor gallery at the marked far quay.
points.detail: The landing is reachable from the wet east lane. The transfer returns to supported dry ground on the far quay.

points.name: The harbour beneath the harbour
points.text: The lower court has benches and maintained lamps, not a tomb.
points.detail: Only this small gallery and visitor air court are authored. Oristhal’s distant skyline is scenery and does not claim full-city access.

quest.title: A visitor’s route through Farwake
quest.completionText: The ordinary Farwake visitor route is checked and recorded. The public dry passage remains available; the regional harbour story has not been settled.
